segments.name: After heart, chest and upper-abdominal surgery
segments.text: The current focus. The same breathing exercise is taught after chest, upper-abdominal, cancer and weight-loss operations, so one hospital can add more surgery types without new hardware.
segments.caution: Evidence is best for lung-cancer surgery as part of a bundle; it is weak for upper-abdominal surgery alone.

segments.name: Before surgery (prehabilitation)
segments.text: Enrol the patient at booking instead of discharge. The strong pre-surgery evidence is for a different device, a breathing-muscle trainer, so we do not borrow its numbers.
segments.caution: Needs its own care plan and a clinical adviser.

segments.name: After TB treatment
segments.text: About 26 lakh TB patients were notified in 2024, about 18.5 lakh of them with lung TB. This needs a basic-phone mode and a programme partner, and the buyer is a state programme, not a hospital.
segments.caution: No trial of the spirometer alone; the programme's draft rehab guidance lists it among breathing exercises.

segments.name: Long-term lung disease (COPD)
segments.text: 5.53 crore people had COPD in 2016 (4.2% of the population). Rehab is not routinely available, but the spirometer is only a small part of rehab.
segments.caution: Evidence for the device is thin; long-term engagement is a different product problem.

honest: This is a tens-of-crores market, not a thousands-of-crores one (B1-10). That is a real but small market on post-surgery alone.
No Indian count exists for thoracic, weight-loss or upper-abdominal operations, so we start from all major operations and an assumed share (B1-9).
Many Indian wards seem to use the three-ball spirometer, which our sensor cannot read. Unless we supply the spirometer, the 10-30% share may be too high (E-12, not confirmed).

sdg.wording: Universal health coverage, including access to quality essential health-care services
sdg.link: Brings follow-up of a standard post-surgery exercise, and the prescription, into the home in the patient's language.

sdg.link: Supports recovery after heart and cancer surgery and, later, lung-disease rehab. We support it; we do not claim to move the death rate.
